subject: Cryptographic evidence chain SEQ gap explanation
documented_by: DPL Phase 3 / Phase 2 Strict Remediation — Item 11
gap_summary: Chain SEQ numbers 1-14 are absent. The chain jumps from SEQ=0 (GENESIS) to SEQ=15.
root_cause: /tmp era: SEQ counter was stored in /tmp/portfolio_engine_verify_seq before workspace session 2026-07-19. /tmp is reset on every Replit VM restart. Runs in sessions prior to 2026-07-19 incremented the counter but the counter reset to 0 each time, causing SEQ collisions and eventual loss when the VM restarted.

era_1.note: These runs existed only in memory and /tmp. No durable evidence exists.

era_2.durability: PARTIAL — SCRIPT_DIR is workspace-durable but LOG_FILE is overwritten each run
era_2.note: SEQ=3 log was overwritten by subsequent runs.

era_3_missing.durability: SEQ file durable but archive (tools/logs/) did not exist yet
era_3_missing.note: SEQ 4-14 were incremented and logged to verified_run_last.log which is overwritten each run. No per-SEQ archives existed before the logs/ directory was introduced.

genesis_explanation: SEQ=0 is a synthetic GENESIS entry created on 2026-07-19T14:51:15Z to anchor the forward chain. Its pre_chain_anchor_note field documents the /tmp era. All subsequent chain entries (SEQ=15+) chain from this GENESIS. The GENESIS entry_hash covers the SHA-256 of the last known durable log (verified_run_last.log at the time of anchoring).

chain_continuity_proof.verifiable: Yes — every entry from SEQ=15 forward has verified prev_hash continuity (C33 PASS). The gap 1-14 is documented here, not in the chain, because retroactive insertion would break chain integrity.

why_not_retroactively_filled: Inserting entries for SEQ 1-14 would require rewriting existing chain entries (changing their prev_hash values), which would break the integrity of all subsequent entries and defeat the purpose of a cryptographic hash chain. The gap is instead documented here.
audit_status: DOCUMENTED — gap is explainable, structural, and non-exploitable. No trades occurred during the /tmp era (paper trading was not yet active). No evidence was tampered with; the evidence simply did not persist.
references: tools/verified_run.sh header comment: 'SEQ CHAIN DISCONTINUITY NOTE (recorded 2026-07-19)'
